body: Default home = variable ABSENT. When launching on the default home (~/.claude, ~/.codex) REMOVE CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME from the child env; set it only for non-default homes. Setting CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR even to ~/.claude makes Claude Code (v2.1.52+) use the hashed keychain name `Claude Code-credentials-<sha256(dir)[:8]>` and the account looks logged out. Code: provider.HomeEnv; guarded by TestProvider_Launch / TestLaunch (they assert removal). Never 'simplify' Launch to always set it (found 2026-09-24).
